cases.title: Form 4 filed: Ryan Cohen bought 450,000 GME shares on Sept 29
cases.text: New Form 4 on EDGAR today. Ryan Cohen (CEO, Chairman) purchased 450,000 shares in two open-market transactions at $23.4753 and $23.4499, about $10.56 million total. Direct ownership after the transactions: 40,948,522 shares.

cases.title: GameStop names new independent director to its board
cases.text: GameStop announced that its board of directors has appointed a new independent director, effective immediately. The company said the appointment expands the board and that the director will serve on the audit committee.

cases.title: GameStop director Larry Cheng bought 55,000 shares
cases.text:
Director Larry Cheng purchased 55,000 shares at $18.80 through Cheng Capital, about $1.03 million.
